info.author: Kartikey Baghel
info.description: "Clean Temp" is an application designed to help users efficiently clean up temporary files and folders from their computer. Temporary files are created by various applications and processes on a computer and are intended to be used for a short period of time. However, these files can accumulate over time, taking up valuable disk space and slowing down the computer's performance.

info.name: Clean-Temp
info.summary: The "Clean Temp" application provides a simple and user-friendly interface that allows users to quickly scan their computer for temporary files and folders.
